items.question: In the UAE, is a test required for a student to switch from one school to another under Ministry of Education regulations?
items.gold: No, no test is required to switch schools within the UAE under MoE regulations.
items.fact: No test needed to switch schools within UAE

items.question: What is the number of the Ministerial Decree of 2014 on Registration Terms for Students that contains the rules on transferring between schools in the UAE?
items.fact: Registration Terms decree governing school transfers is No. 820
